x: Terry Samuels · Track, Field, Race Walking

Terry Samuels was fifth in the same race. Laura Fryer who only a month earlier was on crutches with a badly twisted ankle and walking against the advice of her coach, surprised everybody with her determination and shear guts.
Our U15 boys came 2nd and 3rd thanks to Paul Graham and Stephen Whorlow but the best result of the day was in the U13 boys' race where Ben Craig, Richard Harris and Terry Samuels made it a 1, 2, 3.
